verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a first-class Conversions API for executing conversions between supported assets, plus one-call mint (USD→stablecoin) and redeem (stablecoin→USD) orchestrations. Its brokerage API offers held-rate quotes, and USDG is documented as 1:1 redeemable for USD, which establishes the rate for Paxos stablecoins. However, the evidence never documents conversion fees or settlement times, and does not explicitly confirm stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion. missing for 10: documented conversion fees, documented settlement times, explicit stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion coverage, quotes tied specifically to stablecoin conversions, independent/hands-on corroboration.
